ns2:section.sectionText: An introduction to Indian mainstream cinema, known in its current form as Bollywood, and its evolution through the last 7 decades. Topics to be explored include the relation between Indian society/culture and its cinematic representations, cinema's resistance to dominant nationalist and patriarchal ideologies, its interactions with the postcolonial nation-state of India, how globalization has changed the industry, etc. All films will be screened with subtitles. No knowledge of Hindi or any other Indian language is required. This course is open to all majors.
